title: Advanced Traffic Flow Simulation with Scoring
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an advanced 3D traffic flow simulation using Three.js. The scene simulates vehicles moving through an intersection with a scoring system.

## Scene Setup
- Use a perspective camera at position (0, 40, 50) looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (0xffffff, 0.5) and a directional light (0xffffff, 0.8) at (20, 40, 20).
- Create a flat ground plane (100x100) in dark gray (0x333333) representing the road area.
- Draw road markings: two perpendicular roads crossing at the origin, each 10 units wide, using lighter gray (0x555555) planes slightly above the ground.
- Add lane dividers as thin yellow (0xffcc00) lines along each road center.
- Load the 'DamagedHelmet.glb' model using GLTFLoader from CDN (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.157.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js). Scale it to (2, 2, 2) and place it at (20, 2, 20) as a decorative roadside monument/sculpture. Store reference in window.__3D_STATE__.monument.
- OrbitControls for camera interaction, imported from CDN.

## Vehicle System
- Create vehicles as colored boxes (2x1x3 units). Maintain an array of vehicle objects.
- Vehicles spawn from 4 directions: North (z=-50), South (z=50), East (x=50), West (x=-50).
- Each vehicle has properties: id, speed (random 0.05-0.2), direction, color, stopped (boolean).
- Vehicles move toward the intersection and continue through to the opposite side, then are removed.
- Start with 0 vehicles. Auto-spawn a new vehicle every 2 seconds from a random direction.
- Vehicle colors: North=blue(0x3366ff), South=red(0xff3333), East=green(0x33cc33), West=orange(0xff9933).

## Traffic Light System
- Place 4 traffic light posts (thin cylinders) at the 4 corners of the intersection at positions (±7, 0, ±7).
- Each post has a light indicator (small sphere on top) that shows red or green.
- Two phases: Phase A = North/South green + East/West red. Phase B = East/West green + North/South red.
- Traffic lights cycle automatically every 8 seconds.
- When a vehicle approaches a red light (within 8 units of origin on its axis), it stops. When green, it proceeds.
- Store current phase in window.__3D_STATE__.trafficPhase ('A' or 'B').

## Scoring System
- Track: vehiclesSpawned, vehiclesCompleted (passed through), collisions, score.
- Each vehicle that successfully passes through: +10 points.
- A collision occurs when two vehicles from perpendicular directions are both within 3 units of origin simultaneously. Each collision: -25 points.
- Display score, vehicles spawned, completed, and collisions on a HUD overlay.

## User Interactions
- Press 'Space' to manually toggle the traffic light phase immediately.
- Press 'S' to spawn an additional vehicle from a random direction immediately.
- Press 'P' to pause/resume the simulation.
- Press 'R' to reset the entire simulation (score=0, remove all vehicles, reset counters).
- A DOM button with id='speed-toggle' that cycles simulation speed: 1x, 2x, 3x (multiplies vehicle speeds and spawn rate).

## HUD Elements
- A div with id='hud' positioned top-left showing:
  - Score (id='score-display')
  - Vehicles Spawned (id='spawned-display')
  - Vehicles Completed (id='completed-display')
  - Collisions (id='collision-display')
  - Current Phase (id='phase-display')
  - Sim Speed (id='speed-display')
  - Paused status (id='pause-display')

## State Management (window.__3D_STATE__)
Expose the following on window.__3D_STATE__:
- score: number (starts at 0)
- vehiclesSpawned: number (starts at 0)
- vehiclesCompleted: number (starts at 0)
- collisions: number (starts at 0)
- trafficPhase: string ('A' or 'B', starts 'A')
- paused: boolean (starts false)
- simSpeed: number (1, 2, or 3, starts 1)
- vehicleCount: number (current active vehicles in scene)
- monumentLoaded: boolean (true when DamagedHelmet.glb loaded)
- monument: Object3D reference
- elapsedTime: number (seconds since start, paused when paused)
- lightCycleTimer: number (seconds remaining in current phase, 0-8)

Use requestAnimationFrame loop. Track delta time. All timers respect pause state and simSpeed multiplier.
physics_constraints: Vehicles move at constant speed along their axis. Vehicles stop within 8 units of origin when facing a red light. Collision detection: two perpendicular vehicles both within 3 units of origin center. Vehicles are removed when they pass beyond ±55 on their travel axis. Score is always an integer. Timer counts down from 8 and resets on phase change.
